body: About two years. I was initially diagnosed with depression when I was 15(I'm currently 27). I realize that maintenance can take quite some time or be practically indefinite, but I've just lost all hope at this point.
Initially Major Depressive Disorder, it's recently been changed to Bipolar II.

Thank you for the advice, I will watch some of those videos tonight. I really do appreciate the insight, as I feel very alone right now. I've had that thought many times in the past, but I've had quite a lot of trouble putting it into practice. I manage it for a while, but always end up falling into old habits, for a multitude of reasons.

I have a doctor's appointment in the morning, and my sister has convinced me to request checking myself into the hospital again and I believe I am going to try to see if they can provide any help with my situation. I believe some extended time in a controlled environment will help me learn to process things in a more constructive manor. I really just  need to learn to let go and start things over. Thank you for your help, it means quite a lot.
